verdict.rationale: x402 Bazaar is Coinbase's own documented discovery catalog. Sellers built on the CDP SDK are listed automatically after a successful settled payment and surfaced to agents through CDP APIs, the Bazaar MCP server and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and a runtime probe confirmed the keyless discovery index returns real listings. However, it is not a merchant feed or import API: there is explicitly no registration form or API call, so the merchant cannot push or curate a catalog. It only indexes individual payment-gated HTTP endpoints rather than a general product catalog, and listings drop after 30 days without a settlement. Missing for 10: a documented merchant-side feed/import API for pushing catalog data, support for product catalogs beyond payable endpoints, listing control independent of settlement activity, and independent seller-side corroboration of getting discovered.
